hypotheses.D0_batched_and_single_jvps_match: Batched and single-example suffix JVPs have cosine at least 0.999999 and relative error at most 1e-5 in every cell.
hypotheses.D1_forward_reverse_ad_duality_holds: Random-output JVP/VJP dot-product duality has relative error at most 1e-4 for every probe.
hypotheses.D2_a_smaller_finite_step_validates_the_d: At one shared epsilon every cell has minimum cosine at least 0.999 and maximum relative error at most 0.02.
hypotheses.D3_the_original_step_measures_finite_cur: Epsilon 0.01 has maximum relative error at least 0.05 while AD duality passes.
hypotheses.D4_suffix_curvature_increases_with_depth: At each epsilon, Layer 1 has greater median finite-difference error than Layer 0 on both corpora.
